mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) at the decision date is associated with higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity valuations and increase the attractiveness of equities relative to fixed income.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level (HOUST) above 1400 thousand units signals a strong housing market and underlying economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy supports corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%) combined with strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 20000 billion) signals a robust economic expansion, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth is supported.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window
